about_the_game:
“Magical Girl Witch Trials Demo: First-victim Edition” allows players to experience the game ”Magical Girl Witch Trials” up until the middle of the game’s first case.
We’d love for you to try out the demo, and then add the game to your Wishlist!

■About the Demo
The demo allows players to play through the following parts of Chapter 1:
- The exploration segment (excluding the exploration that occurs after the trial)
- The beginning of the Witch Trial segment
Some core story beats are not available to experience in the demo. We apologize for keeping you waiting.

■Differences Between the Demo and the Final Product
We have limited access to the following features in the demo.
- The map used to quick-travel
- Some features of the Witchpedia (the list of the rules within the prison, etc.)
- Save data from the demo cannot be transferred to the final game.
We also are planning for a variety of other changes in the final game, due to it still being in development. Some story/presentation elements and functions may be changed in the final product.
Please note that this demo is currently not available in English.

■Inquiries
Please report any bugs/errors to this address:
info<at>reaer.net (<at>=@)

■Let Us Know What You Think
We would love to see what you think of the demo.
Please use the hashtag “#まのさば” on your favorite social media service.
If you mention any spoilers, please add the tag “#まのさばネタバレ” in order to protect the experiences of other players.

content_descriptors.notes:
Please note that the information stated below is only applicable to the demo version of the game, and may differ from the final product.
This game features teenage girl protagonists who possess magical abilities and are referred to as "magical girls" (魔法少女) or "witches" (魔女) throughout the story. The gameplay taking place in the courtroom is referred to as the "Witch Trial" (魔女裁判) within the game's fictional world, and is not intended to be discriminatory toward any real-world groups or minorities.
As a part of of the investigation and courtroom experience, the game contains depictions of violence, including murder scenes. While most violent depictions appear as text descriptions or indirect visual references that can be avoided through player choices during gameplay, some violent imagery is presented directly during investigation and trial sequences required for story progression. These scenes might also serve as evidence during trials and may be referenced multiple times during the trial sequences. Violence and gore, however, is mostly presented through artistic, unrealistic imagery without using jump scare tactics in order to reduce psychological impact while retaining the game's atmosphere.

short_description: Thirteen girls awaken, only to find themselves in a prison. What awaits them: a Witch Trial. Help them prepare for the trial by exploring the prison in order to find the witch hidden amongst them. Find the witch, learn what kind of magic she holds, dispel the lies, and prepare for the execution.
